verses.en: May the hands of Abu Lahab be ruined! May he be ruined too!
Neither his wealth nor his gains will help him:
verses.ar: مَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُ مَالُهُۥ وَمَا كَسَبَ

verses.en: he will burn in the Flaming Fire––
and so will his wife, the firewood-carrier,
with a palm-fibre rope around her neck.
